rationale: Fixes crash when removing a Windows PopupMenu submenu by deferring the md_sub lookup and adding a null check; base native_menu_windows.cpp set_item_submenu matches upstream pre-image.
Self-contained MSVC-only __declspec(guard(nocf)) hardening on the two IAT hook functions; no-op on non-MSVC via macro. Low risk even though not compiled on macOS.

Sets default symbol visibility to hidden (-fvisibility=hidden) in macos detect.py; must be ported together with #115868 (a6623908) which re-exports main(), and check GDExtension/plugin symbol exports still resolve. Verifiable via macOS build.
One line: setTreatsFilePackagesAsDirectories:YES lets the native macOS dialog browse into bundles; self-contained in display_server_macos.mm.
Returns an empty IME rect when no text control is active to hide input-accessory popups; target is foundry_content_view.mm in the fork (rename from godot_content_view.mm).
Fixes 'Show In File Manager' launching bundle apps by checking DirAccess::is_bundle (present in base) before treating a path as a folder; self-contained in os_macos.mm.

Marks main() with __attribute__((visibility(default))); trivial. Target file is foundry_main_macos.mm in the fork (rename from godot_main_macos.mm). Pairs with #109958 (114cb3a) hidden default visibility.
Fixes FD leak in Wayland embedder by returning sent-FDs vector; self-contained, embedder exists in base, but reworks a helper signature.
shell_open uses create_process instead of blocking execute to avoid UI freeze; self-contained os_linuxbsd fix, absent in base.
Swaps Wayland BTN_SIDE/BTN_EXTRA to correct XBUTTON1/2 mapping; base still has the swapped mapping, self-contained.
Adds a null check on the NSURL before building an NSBundle in get_framework_executable; self-contained defensive fix in os_macos.mm.

Rewrites confined-mouse warp math to use screen coordinates so confined movement stays in sync; self-contained in display_server_macos.mm and verifiable on macOS. Behavioral, test mouse-confine after port.
Adds nullptr checks for script_debugger in LayerHost::gui_input; embedded_process_macos.mm exists in the fork base, clean defensive fix.
Guards a macOS 26 API (CGDirectDisplayID) behind __MAC_OS_X_VERSION_MAX_ALLOWED so builds work with Xcode older than 26; valuable for local macOS builds.
Prefer gimli/llvm-addr2line over binutils in crash handler; self-contained, absent in base (base still calls plain addr2line).
Fixes String output variable scoping in addr2line detection; small and self-contained but depends on 115566 landing first.
Wake for events when Magnet window manager is running to avoid stalled redraws; self-contained in os_macos.mm add_frame_delay.
Adds <cstdio> include so linux template_release compiles; the include change is guard-independent, absent in base.
Passes the current process environment to child processes in create_process (fixes Steam time tracking on project relaunch); self-contained in os_macos.mm.

Forces ANGLE (GL-over-Metal) when running in a VM (Virtual processor name) and fails cleanly if ANGLE init fails; GLES3 gl_manager_angle block exists in base. Behavioral, valuable for VM/software-render CI; verify against fork's rendering_driver handling.
Adds encoding='utf-8' to the SVG open in platform_builders.py icon generator; runs during the macOS build, trivial and safe.
Includes core/typedefs.h in display_server_macos_base.h to prevent AppKit MAX/MIN macro clashes; base file exists, clean one-liner.
One-line determinism fix: sort extra_frameworks before emitting -framework flags to stabilize macOS incremental link order.

Self-contained fix for invalid transient window infinite loop in delete_sub_window plus on-top/transient guard; base matches upstream pre-image. Needs mechanical WindowID/INVALID_WINDOW_ID enum-namespace adaptation.
Destroy/recreate Wayland data source each copy so clipboard history updates; self-contained, absent in base.

Accessibility fix: set FOCUS_NONE on ScrollContainer scroll bars in scene/gui/scroll_container.cpp (compiled, verifiable). The detect.py hunk only removes a duplicated accesskit include that does not exist in the fork base; drop it and port only the scroll_container change.

Crash-handler improvement printing frame PCs and module load address; macOS/linux compiled here (base has load_addr). Foundation for 118676; Windows signal handler gains module-info machinery (diagnostic-only).
Wraps libdecor-only code in #ifdef LIBDECOR_ENABLED to fix libdecor=no build; self-contained guard, absent in base.
One-line: reset ime_active=false in _xim_destroy_callback; self-contained, absent in base.

Adds module name/offset to crash backtraces; macOS(.mm)/linux are compiled here so it gets real coverage. Must be ordered after 521e44 (it builds on that print format); Windows portion is diagnostic-only.
Consolidates IME composition/candidate positioning into a new update_ime_form_positions helper; base WM_IME_COMPOSITION and window_set_ime_position match upstream pre-image. Prereq for 118893.
Self-contained IME composition-font fix inside update_ime_form_positions; must be ordered after 28200b which introduces that helper. Windows-only, not compiled here so verify visually.
Additive: track/forward keyboard modifier state in Wayland embedder; embedder exists in base, no absent 4.7 infra.
Adds XSync/error-handler restore around X11 embed_process to swallow BadWindow errors; self-contained, absent in base.
One-line copy-paste fix (height fallback should use size.height not width); base still has the bug at wayland_thread.cpp.
3-line fix moving release_pressed_events to true focus loss; self-contained, absent in base.

Fixes poll_export mutating the current export_preset; replacement helpers has_valid_export_configuration/has_valid_project_configuration exist in base and web export_plugin.cpp compiles into the macOS editor.
